chunks: Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah, from Al-Abbas ibn Aamir, from Aban, from Muhammad ibn Al-Fazl Al-Hashimi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

Two rak'at from the Sunnah are not prayed in any place except in Medina. He would pray in the Masjid of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) during Eid, before he goes out to the musalla (praying place). That is nowhere except in Medina, because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did so.

key_terms.مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The Mosque of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and location of the two Sunnah rak'at of Eid prayer in Medina?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights a specific Sunnah of two rak'at performed by the Prophet (SAW) in Masjid al-Nabi before departing for the Eid musalla, a practice uniquely tied to Medina as indicated by the phrase 'not except in Medina.' It underscores the significance of the Prophet's direct precedent in structuring the Eid day's worship, distinguishing the pre-departure prayer in the mosque from the main congregational prayer in the open field. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on adhering strictly to the Prophet's established rituals in their original context.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abdullah, from Al-Abbas Bin Aamir, from Aban, from Muhammad Bin Al-Fazl Al-Hashimy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Two Rak’at (of the Salāt) are from the Sunnah. These two are not prayed in any place except in Al-Medina. He would pray Salāt in the Masjid of Rasool-Allahsaww during the Eid, before he goes out to the praying place. That is nowhere except in Al-Medinca, because Rasool-Allahsaww did so’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn al-Flassan ibn Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah has narrated from al-‘Abbas ibn ‘Amir from Aban from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl al- Flashimiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

There are two Rak‘at Salah (prayer) which are of Sunnah but they are not performed anywhere else except in a certain place of al-Madinah.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is performed in Masjid of the Messenger of Allah on ‘Id before going out to the place for Salah (prayer). It is not done anywhere else except al-Madinah; the Messenger of Allah did so.’”
